--- FILE: .plaesy/spec/habit-tracking-app/spec.md ---
# Spec: Habit-Tracking App for University Students

Status: draft
Topic: habit-tracking-app

## Purpose

A mobile habit-tracking application designed for university students to build and maintain healthy routines across academic, physical, and mental wellness domains. The app provides simple logging, progress visualization, and social accountability features to help students develop consistent habits during their years of study.

## Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Acceptance criterion (Given / When / Then) | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | Users can create habits with custom names and descriptions | Given a logged-in user on the home screen, when they tap "Add habit" and enter a habit name and optional description, then the habit appears in their habit list | open |
| R2 | Users can log daily completion of a habit | Given a user with at least one habit created, when they tap the habit on their dashboard, then they can mark it as completed for today with a single tap, and the app records the completion timestamp | open |
| R3 | Users can view a visual streak counter for each habit | Given a user with a habit that has been logged consecutively, when they view the habit detail page, then they see the current streak count displayed prominently | open |
| R4 | Users can see weekly progress charts for habits | Given a user with at least 7 days of habit data, when they view the dashboard, then they see a weekly chart showing completion percentage or days completed per habit | open |
| R5 | Users can organize habits by category | Given a user creating or editing a habit, when they assign it to a category (e.g., "Health," "Academics," "Wellness"), then habits are grouped by category on the dashboard | open |
| R6 | Users receive reminders for habits at customizable times | Given a user with reminders enabled for a specific habit, when the scheduled time arrives, then the app sends a push notification with a customizable message | open |
| R7 | Users can invite friends and see their habits on a friends list | Given a user in the app's social feature screen, when they search for and add another user, then they can view that user's habits and streaks (with permission) | open |
| R8 | Users can set habit frequency (daily, multiple times per week, or specific days) | Given a user creating a habit, when they select frequency options, then the app only shows reminders and expects logging on selected days | open |
| R9 | Users receive motivational notifications for milestones (7-day, 30-day, 90-day streaks) | Given a user reaching a streak milestone, when they log completion on that day, then the app sends a celebration notification | open |
| R10 | Users can view their habit history and export a report | Given a user on the profile page, when they select "View history" or "Export," then they see detailed logging history or can download a CSV report of their habit data | open |

## Non-goals

- Habit recommendations based on AI analysis
- Integration with calendar apps or academic schedules
- In-app purchase or premium tiers (free version only)
- Support for habits with time-tracking duration
- Habit challenges or competitions beyond friend visibility
- Integration with fitness trackers or health APIs
- Dark mode UI variant
- Multi-language support beyond English

## Open questions

- UNKNOWN: What is the target launch timeline for MVP? Owner: Product Manager.
- UNKNOWN: Should the app support offline logging with sync when reconnected? Owner: Engineering Lead.
- ASSUMED — All users are 18+: University students are assumed to be adults; no special COPPA compliance is needed.
- ASSUMED — Push notifications are optional: Users can disable notifications; the app functions fully without them.
- ASSUMED — Free app with no monetization: No in-app purchases, ads, or paid tiers in initial release.
- UNKNOWN: Should deleted habits be recoverable from trash, or permanently deleted immediately? Owner: Product Manager.
- UNKNOWN: What is the minimum device OS version to support (iOS and Android)? Owner: Engineering Lead.

## References

- No external sources required; spec based on user request only.
